data.name: Melted Kingdoms
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the Melted Kingdoms, a desolate world of ruin and forgotten secrets!

Explore ancient castles, descend into the depths of underground caverns, and wander among the remnants of civilizations destroyed by the Cataclysm. These lands are filled with unexpected adventures, dangerous encounters, extraordinary creatures, political intrigue, and large-scale conflicts, where every choice you make leads to serious consequences.

Key features:

  • Classic CRPG Experience - A deep, story-driven RPG inspired by legendary old-school classics.

  • Deep Character Customization - Build your own unique hero and define who you are in this broken world.

  • Meaningful Player Choice - Your decisions shape the quests, factions, environment, and story endings.

  • Deep Dialogue System - Branching conversations with skill checks, special perks, reputation requirements, and alternative solutions.

  • Deep Inventory System - Manage hero equipment, discover meaningful loot, and engage with rich crafting systems.

  • Turn-Based Tactical Combat - Thoughtful, position-based combat where preparation, abilities, and equipment matter more than reflexes.

  • Open World - Travel freely across a handcrafted world filled with secrets, shortcuts, and hidden locations.
